title: Warpage sample fixture plates, two parts

fields.projectJobName: Shadow moire fixture set for SYN-10001
fields.scopeOfWork: Two fixture parts that hold the SYN-10001 socket flat in the warpage chamber without loading the seating plane. Critical: pocket depth 2.00 +/-0.02 mm and flatness 0.02 mm on the datum face; break all edges; no anodize on the datum face (it reflects). Inspect the pocket depth and flatness and send the report with the parts.

step3_rows.itemNotes: Datum face lapped; see drawing note 3.

fields.additionalInformation: Parts are used at up to 260 C, so no plastic inserts. Call me if the flatness cannot be held; a 0.03 mm flatness is acceptable for the clamp ring.

why_good: One job with every part listed, sharing the requester, cost center and job details.
Each part has its drawing and matching STEP file.
Scope gives the purpose, critical features with tolerances, finish and inspection.
Says what can be relaxed if a tolerance cannot be held.
